metadata.source_note: Minimal contract for a local-only CREATURE_ATTACKS -> DISCARD_CARDS bridge with strict explicit wording and no parser/IR/profile changes.

bridge_kind.label: creature_attacks -> discard_cards
bridge_kind.purpose: Enable strict local closure where an explicit this-creature-attacks trigger co-exists with local target player/opponent or defending player discard payoff wording.

activation_scope.description: Bridge applies only within the same local card/profile.

activation_predicate.text_evidence_policy: Require explicit wording equivalent to 'Whenever this creature attacks, target player/opponent discards a card.' or '... defending player discards a card.'
honesty_constraints: Reject 'one or more creatures attack' wording.
Reject discard text without explicit this-creature-attacks trigger.
Do not infer DRAW_CARDS -> DISCARD_CARDS from this bridge.
